## 中文

Captiono `v1.6.1` 重点打磨字幕跟随、批注交互与 Bilibili 页面兼容性。

### 改进

- 手动浏览字幕时暂停自动跟随，完全空闲 8 秒后自动回到当前字幕。
- 鼠标停留、文本选择、批注编辑、搜索和设置期间不会抢夺滚动位置。
- 批注支持紧凑原位编辑、点击外部关闭、回车保存、精确选区标记与线程计数。
- README 新增真实批注和“把学习内容交给任意 AI”的完整工作流。

### 稳定性

- Bilibili 等待原生页面稳定后再挂载，并默认折叠，避免影响顶部个人状态栏和推荐内容。
- 修复站内切换、选集、分享按钮及推荐视频可能受 Captiono 影响的问题。
- 修复字幕行、按钮和设置菜单悬浮抖动，以及无字幕页面的重复刷新。
- 加强 YouTube / Bilibili 字幕与当前视频身份绑定，避免新视频显示旧字幕。

> Captiono 只读取平台已有字幕，不录制音频，也不会自动把字幕或批注发送给外部 AI。

---

## English

Captiono `v1.6.1` focuses on playback following, inline annotations, and Bilibili host-page compatibility.

### Improvements

- Pauses automatic following during manual browsing and returns to the active caption after eight seconds of complete inactivity.
- Pointer presence, text selection, annotation editing, search, and settings postpone automatic following.
- Adds compact inline annotation editing, outside-click dismissal, Enter-to-save, exact-range markers, and thread counts.
- Adds real annotation and bring-your-own-AI workflows to the README.

### Stability

- Waits for a stable native Bilibili layout before mounting and starts collapsed to protect personal navigation and recommendations.
- Fixes interference with in-site navigation, episode selection, sharing controls, and recommended videos.
- Fixes hover jitter and repeated refreshes on videos without captions.
- Strengthens active-media binding so a new YouTube or Bilibili video never shows stale captions.

> Captiono reads existing platform captions only. It does not record audio or automatically send captions or annotations to an external AI.
